newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-FREUND WORRIED ABOUT FUTURE AFTER KNEE OPERATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FREUND WORRIED ABOUT FUTURE AFTER KNEE OPERATION.

text.p: Germany's Euro 96 midfielder Steffen Freund was forced to undergo another knee operation on Thursday and admitted he was worried about his future in soccer.
Freund, who first tore ligaments in his left knee in Germany's victory over England in the semifinals of last year's European championship, hurt the knee again in training three weeks ago.
The Borussia Dortmund player, who turns 27 later this month, knows that there is a possibility that the injury could bring his career to a premature end.
"The physiotherapists, doctors and my family are all saying that everything will be okay," he said. "I don't want to give up hope but I simply have to confront the idea of invalidity."
